_comment: Every product that has appeared in any Breakpoint MCP competitive-analysis sweep,
carried forward permanently.  An entry is never dropped: products that stop moving
are marked `dormant` or `archive` and keep their ruling, so a later sweep does not
`assetlib_version` / `assetlib_modify_date` are what the live Asset Library API
served when this entry was last reconciled; scripts/assetlib_sweep.py compares
the live API against them and reports anything that moved.
`last_analysed` is the date of the last SOURCE-LEVEL pass, which is a stronger
claim than a version check.  When a sweep reports an entry moved, it owes a
source-level pass; when it reports no change, `no change since <last_analysed>`
is a complete and sufficient result for that entry.
House terminology: these are ALTERNATIVE MCP SERVERS, not rivals.  See

entries.name: godot-mcp-go
entries.note: Ruling holds: services/debugger_bridge.gd extends EditorDebuggerPlugin and drives the editor's own Debugger dock — reads the stack via panel signals (_on_stack_dump, _on_stack_frame_var) and steps by pressing the dock's buttons (press/buttons/frame_item walk the panel's Tree). 1f2592f..9ff512b is eighteen commits, mostly docs and CI. 🔴 protocol_revision corrected from 2026-07-28 to 2025-06-18 — cmd/godot-mcp/serve.go declares mcpProtocolVersion 2025-06-18 and the roster's value was never in the source.

entries.name: godot-ai
entries.note: Largest operation in the category by test count and CI breadth.

entries.name: godot-mcp-enhanced
entries.note: Shipped an interactive debugger at 6394ddb on 2026-08-09 — an EditorDebuggerPlugin subclass (addons/godot_mcp_server/debug/debugger_bridge.gd) driven by ten handlers in debug_commands.gd: set/clear/list breakpoint, stack trace, inspect frame, evaluate, step, continue, pause, reload scripts. The prior ruling breakpoint-gutter-marking-only was taken at 8b56302 (2026-08-08), one commit and one day earlier. Builds against @modelcontextprotocol/core ^2.0.0 and @modelcontextprotocol/server ^2.0.0 — the first tracked entry on the v2 packages.

entries.name: beckett-godot-mcp
entries.note: Source of the per-call engine-error echo idea (Breakpoint D1).

entries.name: Godot-MCP-Native
entries.note: Zero-dependency in-engine packaging; strongest onboarding story in the roster.

entries.name: Godot-MCP (IvanMurzak)
entries.note: C# implementation; requires the Mono/.NET Godot build even for GDScript-only projects. Nine CI workflows — broadest workflow set in the roster. No debugger surface: RuntimeErrorCapture.cs collects errors on three passive channels and runtime-errors-get polls the buffer, with no execution control and no live variable read. 42 tools by two derivations ([AiTool] attributes; ToolId constants). The MCP server itself is a separate binary (gamedev-mcp-server 9.2.5) shared with the author's Unity and Unreal plugins — this repo is a client. adac6de..bd1b8e4 is four commits, all machine-wide auth and version.

entries.name: GameDev-MCP-Server
entries.note: Same author as Godot-MCP; multi-engine successor shape, ships to Docker and NuGet.

entries.name: godot-mcp-bridge
entries.note: Architecturally the closest project to Breakpoint: real DAP + LSP clients, newest spec revision, and a csharp-spike CI workflow.

entries.name: godot-agent-loop
entries.note: Shipped v2.0.0 on 2026-08-04. Behavioural-evaluation CI and a Godot-latest compatibility job.

entries.name: Doyunha-Gopeak
entries.note: Real DAP and LSP clients on the standard ports. First source-level pass 2026-08-10, after being carried unread since the July field survey.

entries.name: fennara-godot-mcp
entries.note: Found by the first automated Asset Library sweep; never tracked before. C++ GDExtension with its own LSP client; nine CI workflows.
